question: Who among the following Indian authors has written the autobiography titled ‘My Story’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamala Das.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"My Story":-**

 
 
• **It is an autobiographical novel written by Indian author and poet Kamala Das, originally published in Malayalam in 1973 under the title "Ente Katha." **
 
• The book garnered immense attention and controversy upon its release, becoming a bestseller and sparking intense debate about gender, sexuality, and societal norms.
 
• The novel chronicles Das's life from her childhood in colonial India to her experiences as a writer and wife.
 
• She candidly explores her struggles, including her complex relationship with her husband, her unconventional sexuality, and her journey towards self-discovery. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Suzanna Arundhati Roy:-**

 
 
• **She is an esteemed Indian author, essayist, political activist, and filmmaker. **
 
• She is renowned for her poignant novel "The God of Small Things," which garnered the prestigious Man Booker Prize in 1997.
 
• Beyond her literary prowess, Roy is a vocal advocate for human rights and environmental causes, championing the marginalized and oppressed communities.
 
 
 
• **Shobhaa De:-**
 
 
• **She is an Indian novelist and columnist. **
 
• She is best known for her depiction of socialites and sex in her works of fiction, for which she has been referred to as the "Jackie Collins of India."
 
 
 
• **Kiran Desai:-**
 
 
• **She is an Indian-American novelist known for her poignant and insightful exploration of themes such as identity, migration, and the complexities of human relationships. **
 
• Her second novel, "The Inheritance of Loss" (2006), garnered international acclaim and won the prestigious Man Booker Prize.
